decisions.detail: QUOTE: Constant-flow testing is done by running the suites under Valgrind (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`) or MemorySanitizer (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`), which flag branches or memory accesses that depend on secret data. | WHY: The answer names the Valgrind/MemSan constant-flow testing but never says it is off-by-default or explicitly not part of the library API. || QUOTE: Constant-flow testing is done by running the suites under Valgrind (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`) or MemorySanitizer (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`), which flag branches or memory accesses that depend on secret data. | WHY: The answer names the Valgrind/MemSan testing, but it never says the facility is off-by-default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API. || QUOTE: Constant-flow testing is done by running the suites under Valgrind (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`) or MemorySanitizer (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`), which flag branches or memory accesses that depend on secret data. | WHY: The answer names Valgrind/MemorySanitizer constant-flow testing but never says it is off by default or explicitly not part of the library API.
